title: Enemy AI

list.name: game_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT game_id FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY game_id

list.name: environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY environment

list.name: build_version
list.query: SELECT '__latest__' AS __value, 'Latest reporting build' AS __text UNION ALL SELECT build_version AS __value, build_version AS __text FROM (SELECT build_version, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY last_seen DESC, build_version DESC)
list.label: Build
list.description: Latest event timestamp for this game/environment, across sources and outside the time picker. Select a version to pin history.

list.name: source_type
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source_type FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated ORDER BY source_type

targets.rawSql: SELECT avgOrNull(JSONExtractFloat(properties,'evaluation_us')) AS mean, quantileOrNull(0.95)(JSONExtractFloat(properties,'evaluation_us')) AS p95 FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='enemy_action')

SELECT countIf(event_name='enemy_action') AS actions, countIf(event_name='enemy_waited') AS waits FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name IN ('enemy_action','enemy_waited'))

SELECT concat(JSONExtractString(properties,'enemy'), ' / ', event_name) AS enemy_action, count() AS actions FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name IN ('enemy_action','enemy_waited')) GROUP BY enemy_action ORDER BY actions DESC, enemy_action LIMIT 30

SELECT JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome') AS outcome, count() AS failures FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='simulation_completed' AND JSONExtractString(properties,'outcome') IN ('softlock','invalid_action','timeout')) GROUP BY outcome ORDER BY failures DESC

SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, avg(JSONExtractFloat(properties,'evaluation_us')) AS mean, quantile(0.95)(JSONExtractFloat(properties,'evaluation_us')) AS p95 FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name='enemy_action') GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Actions and waits over time
panels.description: Counts per adaptive time bucket; empty buckets have no bar.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(timestamp) AS time, event_name, count() AS actions FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} AND build_version=if(${build_version:sqlstring}='__latest__', (SELECT build_version FROM telemetry.events_deduplicated WHERE game_id=${game_id:sqlstring} AND environment=${environment:sqlstring} GROUP BY build_version ORDER BY max(timestamp) DESC, build_version DESC LIMIT 1), ${build_version:sqlstring}) AND source_type=${source_type:sqlstring} AND (event_name IN ('enemy_action','enemy_waited')) GROUP BY time, event_name ORDER BY time, event_name

description: Defaults to the latest reporting build for the selected game/environment, across sources. Historical builds remain selectable. Panels respect the selected time range and source unless labeled global.
